title: backup push: a capture deadline near u64::MAX panics after the capture instead of failing with a typed code
outcome: backup push: a capture deadline near u64::MAX panics after the capture instead of failing with a typed code
acceptance: `engram backup push --capture-deadline-secs 18446744073709551615` (and the same for --transport-deadline-secs) neither panics nor leaves a stage: either the CLI refuses the value before any work, or the deadline is computed with checked arithmetic and an overflow means no limit; a test covers it

`engram backup push --capture-deadline-secs 18446744073709551615` does not panic: a deadline too large for the clock is treated as no deadline for the preparation of the compressed file, as capture_store already treats it, and a test covers it

completion.summary: backup push no longer panics on a deadline too far off for the clock. The preparation deadline is computed with checked_add, and an unrepresentable deadline sets no limit; a representable deadline behaves exactly as before. Tests cover prepare(None), a push with both deadlines at u64::MAX (upload, changed and unchanged store), and the CLI with both flags at 18446744073709551615 (exit 0, empty stage); there is also a doc line. Landed as 4301255 after gate test-0ca9e6a3 passed, a clean review pair (Codex 10013, Claude 10014) and independent evaluation 2/2. Readiness was ready on all 4 stores; build 24f43edf50b9 is installed.
